_meta.purpose: Registry of municipal zoning-by-law polygon data sources for the top TRREB markets, parallel to school-catchment-sources.json. Drives a future zoning harvest -> point-in-polygon backfill -> Typesense zoning_designation pipeline (same machinery as School-Aware Search).
_meta.method: Per-city WebSearch/WebFetch discovery + LIVE token-free ArcGIS REST probes: <layer>/query?where=1=1&returnCountOnly=true&f=json (count), <layer>?f=json (geometryType + fields), and an outFields sample of the zone-code field. Every featureCount below was returned by a successful live probe.
_meta.marketRank: Covers two lenses. (A) Top 15 by transaction count (Toronto districts consolidated): Toronto 10371, Mississauga 2579, Brampton 2124, Hamilton 2110, London 1905, Vaughan 1363, Oakville 1259, Markham 1240, Richmond Hill 1066, Barrie 922, Kawartha Lakes 854, Burlington 820, Oshawa 727, Kitchener 687, Kingston 667. (B) BUILDER-LAND tier (added because transaction count under-weights developable land, which clusters on the urban fringe/exurbs): GTA growth-frontier = Caledon, Clarington, King, Whitchurch-Stouffville, Halton Hills, Milton, Georgina, Uxbridge, Erin; Simcoe fringe = Innisfil, Springwater, Oro-Medonte, Clearview, Tiny; Niagara fringe = Niagara Falls, Fort Erie. Land ranking was by vacant-land + large-lot (>=0.5/1 acre) facets on the live index. 31 municipalities verified total.

statusLegend.verified_open_commercial: Token-free queryable polygon layer AND an open license that permits commercial reuse with attribution. Ingest now.
statusLegend.open_license_gated: Token-free queryable polygon layer, BUT the license prohibits or does not grant commercial reuse. Data is technically retrievable; needs written permission / legal clearance before commercial ingestion.
statusLegend.locked_fallback: No token-free open zoning-by-law polygon layer (token-required service and/or only address-lookup). Use a coarser open proxy (Official Plan land-use) or request access from the City.

harvesterMustHandle: Paginate: every source caps maxRecordCount (1000-2000) and returns exceededTransferLimit; pull with resultOffset/resultRecordCount.
Reproject: native SR varies (UTM17N wkid 26917 or WebMercator 3857) -> request outSR=4326.
MapServer vs FeatureServer: some sources publish only a dynamic MapServer (still supports /query).
Multi-layer sources: Vaughan splits zoning across 12 category sublayers (/MapServer/0..11) - query each.
Status filtering: Richmond Hill By-law 93-25 is under OLT appeal - a STATUS field flags 'Under Appeal' zones.
Coverage gaps: Oakville layer is south of Dundas / Hwy407 only (North Oakville By-law 2009-189 is a separate dataset).

Commercial-clear (16): Toronto, Hamilton, London, Oakville, Barrie, Burlington, Oshawa, Kingston, Milton, Clarington(confirm clause), Springwater, Innisfil, Oro-Medonte, Tiny, Clearview, Niagara Falls. License-gated (12 - do NOT commercially ingest without written clearance): Mississauga, Markham (NON-COMMERCIAL), Vaughan, Richmond Hill, Kawartha Lakes, Kitchener, Whitchurch-Stouffville, King, Georgina, Erin, Fort Erie, Halton Hills (RESTRICTIVE). _meta.countyTierSummary: The `county_tier` section covers the recreational/rural LAND belt (upper-tier/single-tier sweep). Commercial-clear: Frontenac County (OGL, 4 townships - a top-2 large-lot market) + Simcoe County (OGL, 11 townships - the biggest single-license win). License-gated (open ACCESS but commercial PROHIBITED/unconfirmed): Bruce (consolidated layer, all 8), Grey (all 9), Haliburton (partial - Minden Hills missing), Peterborough (all 8 incl. Trent Lakes), Northumberland (only Hamilton Twp/Cobourg/Brighton open; high-land Trent Hills/Alnwick-Haldimand/Cramahe are PDF-locked), Norfolk (unconfirmed). Locked/fallback: District of Muskoka (every township behind a 403 token-proxy; only a 2023 Huntsville academic mirror is open), Prince Edward County (only a settlement-only fragment is reachable; the authoritative By-law 1816-2006 layer is firewalled from datacenter IPs - RE-PROBE from a residential/Canadian IP). PATTERN: rural counties DO publish efficient consolidated/per-township zoning, but mostly under NON-COMMERCIAL licenses; only Frontenac & Simcoe carry commercial OGLs.
_meta.phase1Scope: DECISION (2026-07): harvest ONLY commercial-clear sources (data available AND commercial reuse licensed). Target = 26 municipalities: [cities] Toronto, Hamilton, London, Oakville, Barrie, Burlington, Oshawa, Kingston, Milton, Niagara Falls; [Simcoe County OGL] Springwater, Innisfil, Oro-Medonte, Tiny, Clearview, Wasaga Beach, Severn, Midland, Ramara, New Tecumseth, Bradford West Gwillimbury; [Frontenac County OGL] North Frontenac, Central Frontenac, South Frontenac, Frontenac Islands. Clarington = PENDING (confirm its commercial clause before including). EXCLUDE every license-gated + locked source until written permission is obtained. Start with Toronto (it uniquely carries FSI/unit-count density fields).
_meta.provenanceRequirement: Zoning is sourced from municipal open-data APIs, NOT the MLS/listing feed - it MUST be displayed SEPARATELY and clearly attributed, never blended into MLS-derived columns as if it were listing data. Requirements: (a) per-source attribution string (OGL mandates it, e.g. 'Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Toronto'); (b) label the source municipality + by-law + an 'approximate, not a legal survey' disclaimer; (c) REMOVE the inline Builders 'Zoning' ledger column (empty today + would misrepresent provenance once populated) and present zoning in a dedicated attributed surface; (d) store provenance next to the value (source municipality + by-law + as-of date).
_meta.geometryCaveat: The per-source verification confirmed a queryable layer + count + fields via ArcGIS returnCountOnly — it did NOT prove GEOMETRY is retrievable. Some servers return attributes but SUPPRESS geometry for anonymous /query (confirmed for Toronto's gis.toronto.ca MapServer). At harvest time, verify geometry actually comes back; if not, use the source's open-data DOWNLOAD (CKAN / ArcGIS Hub GeoJSON export) — e.g. Toronto uses the CKAN `geometryDownload`. FeatureServers (Oakville, Hamilton, Simcoe, Frontenac AGOL, etc.) generally do return geometry via query, but confirm each.
